title.zh: Player5 以 14 分夺冠，baseline 12 分次之
title.en: Player5 wins with 14, ahead of baseline on 12

desc.zh: 第 200 回合 v12_control 以 7 分领先。Player5 第 227 回合取得领先后再未落后。终局 Player5 14、baseline 12、v12_control 10，全场共 45 次交旗。
desc.en: v12_control led with 7 at turn 200. Player5 went ahead for good on turn 227. Final: Player5 14, baseline 12, v12_control 10. 45 captures in all.
